options.B: removing metabolic waste products produced by chemical reactions in cells

questions.stem: Urea is produced in the liver by
questions.answer: deamination of excess amino acids (NH₃+CO₂→urea)

questions.stem: Filtration in the kidney occurs at the
questions.answer: glomerulus / Bowman's capsule

questions.stem: Which molecules are NOT filtered at glomerulus?

options.C: plasma proteins and blood cells (too large)

questions.answer: plasma proteins and blood cells (too large)

questions.stem: Selective reabsorption in the proximal tubule returns glucose to blood by
questions.answer: active transport (requires energy/ATP)

questions.stem: ADH (antidiuretic hormone) acts on

options.C: collecting duct and distal tubule — increases water reabsorption

questions.answer: collecting duct and distal tubule — increases water reabsorption

questions.stem: On a hot day with heavy sweating, what happens to ADH secretion?
questions.answer: ADH increases (dehydration detected → conserve water)

questions.stem: Loop of Henle's main function is

options.B: creating osmotic gradient in medulla enabling production of concentrated urine

questions.answer: creating osmotic gradient in medulla enabling production of concentrated urine

questions.stem: Kidney failure is treated by

options.B: dialysis (filters blood artificially) or kidney transplant

questions.answer: dialysis (filters blood artificially) or kidney transplant

questions.stem: Which substance in urine indicates diabetes mellitus (Type 1)?

options.B: Glucose (not normally present — only if blood glucose exceeds renal threshold)

questions.answer: Glucose (not normally present — only if blood glucose exceeds renal threshold)

questions.stem: What is the basic unit of life?
questions.answer: The cell

questions.stem: Which organelle is responsible for energy production in cells?
questions.answer: Mitochondria

questions.stem: What is photosynthesis?

options.A: The process by which plants make food using sunlight
options.B: The breakdown of glucose for energy
options.C: The absorption of minerals from soil

questions.answer: The process by which plants make food using sunlight

questions.stem: What is osmosis?

options.A: Movement of water from high to low water potential through a semi-permeable membrane

questions.answer: Movement of water from high to low water potential through a semi-permeable membrane

questions.stem: What molecule carries genetic information?
questions.answer: DNA (Deoxyribonucleic acid)

questions.stem: What is the function of chloroplasts?
questions.answer: Site of photosynthesis

questions.stem: In genetics, what is a dominant allele?

options.A: One that is expressed even when only one copy is present
options.B: One that is only expressed when two copies are present

questions.answer: One that is expressed even when only one copy is present

questions.stem: What is diffusion?

options.A: Movement of particles from high to low concentration without energy

questions.answer: Movement of particles from high to low concentration without energy

questions.stem: Which blood component carries oxygen?
questions.answer: Red blood cells (haemoglobin)

questions.stem: What is the role of the nucleus?

options.A: Controls cell activities and contains DNA
